mapper.sql: r.id, r.rule_code, r.name, r.app_scenario, r.app_id, a.name AS app_name, r.username, r.retry_policy, r.status
mapper.select:
select from kb_routing_rules r left join kb_apps a on r.app_id = a.id
and ( r.rule_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.app_scenario like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by r.id desc
select from kb_routing_rules r left join kb_apps a on r.app_id = a.id where r.id = #{id}

select from kb_routing_rules r inner join kb_routing_rule_consumers rc on r.rule_code = rc.rule_code inner join kb_routing_consumers c on c.consumer_code = rc.consumer_code left join kb_apps a on r.app_id = a.id where c.id = #{consumerId} and r.status = 1 and rc.status = 1 order by r.id desc

select from kb_routing_rules r inner join kb_routing_rule_consumers rc on r.rule_code = rc.rule_code inner join kb_routing_consumers c on c.consumer_code = rc.consumer_code left join kb_apps a on r.app_id = a.id where c.id = #{consumerId} and r.rule_code = #{ruleCode} and r.status = 1 and rc.status = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_routing_rules(rule_code, name, app_scenario, app_id, username, retry_policy, status) values(#{ruleCode}, #{name}, #{appScenario}, #{appId}, #{username}, #{retryPolicy}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_routing_rules set rule_code = #{ruleCode}, name = #{name}, app_scenario = #{appScenario}, app_id = #{appId}, username = #{username}, retry_policy = #{retryPolicy}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
